where: Under the next commitment on Home's Calendar, in the Day look for today, and beside the next commitment in the Sleep dialog
why: Read on a shoot week before and after (brief 20's D3): a 7 AM call in New York, two hours from New Haven. Before, nothing said when to be in bed until the Sleep dialog, opened at eleven, said there wasn't time for a full night and offered five hours. Now the bedtime a full night asks for is said by the evening before, and past it, that it was.
changes: New: "A full night before it, with an hour to get up and two hours to get there, means being asleep by 8:00 PM." and, past it, "… needed you asleep by 8:00 PM."
